Threat/Risk Description: Break-glass access is used without adequate justification
Recommended Safeguard: Require reason codes and post-access review

Threat/Risk Description: Patient record accessed on mobile device that is lost or compromised
Recommended Safeguard: Mobile device management and session timeout

Threat/Risk Description: Temporary staff retain access beyond clinical need
Specialist sees unrelated sensitive history not needed for care
Incorrect or outdated hospital information is relied on during GP consultation
Privileged account is misused or compromised
Recommended Safeguard: Privileged access monitoring and supplier assurance

Threat/Risk Description: Staff member accesses record without care relationship
Patient cannot see who accessed their record
Identity matching error causes the wrong patient record to be accessed
Recommended Safeguard: Strengthen patient matching and confirmation checks

Threat/Risk Description: Clinician accesses more record sections than needed for the care context
Supplier-side compromise exposes shared record infrastructure
Recommended Safeguard: Require supplier security assurance and monitoring

Threat/Risk Description: Audit logs exist but are not actively reviewed
Recommended Safeguard: Introduce routine and anomaly-based audit review

Threat/Risk Description: Patient objections or sharing preferences are not clearly respected
Recommended Safeguard: Record and enforce patient preferences clearly

Threat/Risk Description: Sensitive records such as mental health safeguarding or reproductive health are overexposed
Recommended Safeguard: Apply segmented access for highly sensitive record categories

Threat/Risk Description: Data from one provider is copied into another system without provenance or update status
Recommended Safeguard: Add provenance source and update-status indicators
